about_the_game:
A puzzle platformer passion project where you manipulate the fabric of space to collect some apples. Tear holes, rotate chunks, and mirror entire columns of space across each other. Collect all the apples with a given set of abilities in each stage.

Ability 1: The hole

Tear a square hole in space with a specified direction, deleting everything inside, terrain included. Afterwards, everything in the column given by the direction specified is pulled into the vacuum. This imparts momentum to the player

Ability 2: The rotation

Rotate a square chunk of space to any angle you wish. Rotating yourself changes your direction of gravity. 

Ability 3: The mirror

Select a reflection line and a direction. Space is reflected across that reflection line.

All abilities work with physics, so you can rotate yourself and maintain the same momentum in your reference frame. 

100% Full refund guaranteed if you find any bugs. No questions asked
